_doc: Grandfathered JS-injection sites in the Tauri shell. Enforced by scripts/webview-injection-guard (CI + pre-push). Numbers are CEILINGS on non-comment occurrences per file; they may only go down. Adding a file, a primitive, or raising a number requires a code-review justification in the PR and a `reason` here. Migrated providers (whatsapp, wechat, telegram, slack, discord, browserscan) must never appear. See CLAUDE.md 'CEF child webviews — no new JS injection' and gitbooks/developing/cef.md.

app/src-tauri/src/cdp/session.rs.reason: Notification-permission shim registered on the per-account CDP session before the provider URL loads (legacy; documented in build_init_script docs).

app/src-tauri/src/meet_audio/inject.rs.reason: Google Meet (grandfathered): audio + captions bridges for the meet agent. Should shrink as Meet moves to CDP-only.

app/src-tauri/src/meet_scanner/mod.rs.reason: Google Meet (grandfathered): scanner reads meeting state via Runtime.evaluate instead of DOM snapshots.

app/src-tauri/src/meet_video/inject.rs.reason: Google Meet (grandfathered): mascot camera bridge injected post-reload via Runtime.evaluate.

app/src-tauri/src/meet_video/mod.rs.reason: Google Meet (grandfathered): camera_bridge.js template baked into the binary.

app/src-tauri/src/webview_accounts/mod.r.reason: Grandfathered recipe bridge (runtime.js + linkedin/google-meet recipes). build_init_script returns an empty script for migrated providers; that invariant is covered by Rust tests, this guard covers the call-site count.
